_doc: Round 3 of the rebuilt-wing angles (criteria: main planes and middle elements attached; last element up to about half separated, not from its leading edge, slot alive). MP4/5 mp45_w4: front main + flap -5 deg at y 0.32-0.43 attached there, but the separation moved inboard to y 0.19-0.28 (suction side 69 % reversed at 0.22-0.25) -> mp45_w5: the same -5 deg from y 0.20 (ramp from 0 at 0.16) to 0.43, 0 at 0.50. Its rear-wing centre (|y| < 0.08) stays separated with -4 deg as with 0: it is the junction of the central pylon with the main plane's suction side, not incidence (and more rotation leaves the pylon top sticking out of the main) -> rear wing back to the model angles. MP4/23 mp423_w5 (rear 10/16 deg, beam outboard 6 deg) passes (rear-wing suction reversed 60 -> 7 %, beam 7 %), but every run with the rebuilt bridge wing (w3-w5) has ~0.2 m2 less ClA from the rear floor and diffuser than w2 (bridge as modelled, attached in 3D) -> mp423_w6 = w5 with the bridge left as modelled (wing_patch skip), to settle the bridge.
